create_pose_data_sample: create a PoseDataSample with gt_instances, gt_fields, and metainfo for pose estimation
set_gt_instances: set ground truth instances with keypoints and bboxes on a PoseDataSample
set_pred_instances: set predicted instances with keypoint predictions on a PoseDataSample
set_gt_fields: set ground truth heatmaps and spatial fields on a PoseDataSample
set_pred_fields: set predicted heatmaps and spatial distributions on a PoseDataSample
